[NFCT.5.4] No-op LOGICAL reassertions ([NFCT.4.4.2]) **do** emit `FACT_ASSERT`.
A `FactAssert` records an assert ARRIVING, not a fact entering working memory
([RFCS.6.7]); the suppression is a working-memory discipline and never reaches
the recorder. Each successful retract emits exactly one `FACT_RETRACT`; the TTL
sweep emits one per expired fact. Within one rule firing these events take the
order [NCBK.2.6] states.
